officialEvidence.directPayment: Official SWM Ladeapp page states ad-hoc charging from 2026-03-01 via QR code with credit-card payment.
officialEvidence.publishedScope: Ad-hoc tariff shown by Stadtwerke Mühlacker for the ladenetz.de network in its own charging app.

decision: The current official page publishes exact QR/card ad-hoc AC/DC prices and time fees. This closes the tariff first pass for the SWM direct ad-hoc product; physical-CPO attachment must still use verified operator identity and must not propagate the tariff to unrelated ladenetz.de CPOs.
